title: Test 18 — Take a picture every 2 minutes, but when you detect a rare event (ex. apoptosis), take it every 10 seconds.
agent_prompt: Using only the DAPI channel, start acquiring images of the sample every 2 minutes. If you find a cell in an apoptotic state, you should acquire images every 10 seconds for the duration of the event. Once the event has ended, you can resume acquiring images every 2 minutes. The experiment will end after 20 minutes or after 3 apoptotic events have been observed. Create a folder to save the general acquisitions and a folder for the images of the apoptotic event. Display the images of the apoptotic events in the napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Images of the acquisition every 2 minutes
Images of the acquisition every 10 seconds
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
